name: Lion
fact: Lions are called the king of the jungle!

name: Elephant
fact: Elephants never forget — they have great memory!

name: Giraffe
fact: Giraffes are the tallest animals on Earth.

name: Dolphin
fact: Dolphins sleep with one eye open!

name: Monkey
fact: Monkeys peel their bananas just like us.

name: Zebra
fact: Every zebra has a unique stripe pattern.

name: Rabbit
fact: Rabbits can jump up to 3 feet high!

name: Frog
fact: Frogs drink water through their skin.

name: Butterfly
fact: Butterflies taste food with their feet!

name: Dog
fact: Dogs can understand up to 250 words and gestures.

name: Cat
fact: Cats can jump up to six times their body length!

name: Tiger
fact: No two tigers have the same stripe pattern.

name: Bear
fact: Bears can smell food from up to 20 miles away!

name: Panda
fact: Giant pandas eat bamboo for up to 14 hours a day.

name: Koala
fact: Koalas sleep up to 22 hours a day to save energy.

name: Kangaroo
fact: Baby kangaroos are called joeys and fit in their mum's pouch.

name: Crocodile
fact: Crocodiles have been on Earth for 200 million years!

name: Whale
fact: Blue whales are the largest animals that have ever lived.

name: Shark
fact: Sharks have been on Earth longer than trees!

name: Octopus
fact: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood!

name: Turtle
fact: Sea turtles can live for over 100 years.

name: Chameleon
fact: Chameleons change colour to show their mood, not to hide.

name: Cheetah
fact: Cheetahs are the fastest land animals, reaching 120 km/h.

name: Gorilla
fact: Gorillas share 98% of their DNA with humans.

name: Chimpanzee
fact: Chimpanzees use sticks and rocks as tools.

name: Sloth
fact: Sloths are so slow that algae grows on their fur!

name: Red Panda
fact: Red pandas use their bushy tail as a blanket in winter.

name: Fox
fact: Arctic foxes change colour with the seasons.

name: Snow Leopard
fact: Snow leopards cannot roar — they chuff and mew.

name: Jaguar
fact: Jaguars are excellent swimmers and love water.

name: Seal
fact: Seals can hold their breath for up to two hours!

name: Hippopotamus
fact: Hippos sweat a red liquid that acts as sunscreen!

name: Rhinoceros
fact: A rhino's horn is made of the same material as our fingernails.

name: Camel
fact: Camels store fat — not water — in their humps.

name: Llama
fact: Llamas spit when they are upset or annoyed.

name: Bison
fact: Bison are the largest land animals in North America.

name: Yak
fact: Yaks can survive in temperatures as low as -40°C.

name: Electric Eel
fact: Electric eels produce shocks of up to 860 volts!

name: King Cobra
fact: The King Cobra is the world's longest venomous snake and lives in Indian forests.

name: Gharial
fact: The Gharial has a long narrow snout perfect for catching fish in Indian rivers.

name: Deer
fact: The Sambar is India's largest deer and is a favourite prey of tigers and leopards.

name: Chinkara
fact: The Chinkara is a small gazelle that can survive in India's dry deserts with very little water.

name: Hyena
fact: The Striped Hyena is India's only hyena species and is mostly active at night.

name: Cow
fact: Cows have best friends and get stressed when they are separated!

name: Horse
fact: Horses can sleep both standing up and lying down.

name: Sheep
fact: Sheep can recognise up to 50 other sheep faces and remember them for years.

name: Goat
fact: Goats were one of the first animals ever domesticated by humans, over 10,000 years ago.

name: Pig
fact: Pigs are smarter than dogs and can learn their name within 2–3 weeks!

name: Chicken
fact: Chickens can remember over 100 different faces of people or animals.

name: Duck
fact: Ducklings bond with the very first moving thing they see after hatching.

name: Donkey
fact: Donkeys have an excellent memory and can recognise places they visited 25 years ago.

name: Buffalo
fact: Domestic buffaloes provide more milk per year than any other cattle in South Asia.

name: Hamster
fact: Hamsters can run up to 8 km in a single night on their wheel!
